answer: Establishment is earned by a graded and passed answer, and it lapses after 26 epochs of inactivity, so a Sybil farm cannot buy a permanent trusted standing — it has to keep every identity continuously honest. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would.. This holds because each vote is weighted by a track record that only grows through honest participation, turning a Sybil flood into short-lived, low-weight votes.
